request: Battery Consumed Columns - Vehicle Snapshots (MAG-10). Add derived columns to vehicle_snapshots computed from the current row and the previous record for that vehicle: distance traveled (odometer delta), battery consumed (battery_level_pct delta, may be negative), km per 1% battery, and estimated range (km_per_pct x 100). Suffix every new column with 'calc'. Calculate them before saving the nightly gathered data. 'Yesterday' means the latest record tracked for that vehicle. Ticket also asks whether the formulas can be applied to existing database records.

decisions.decision: Multi-day gaps store the RAW delta plus a new days_spanned_calc column (five columns, not four)
decisions.why: Preserves the true total while keeping the gap visible; averaging per-day would destroy the real figure irrecoverably, and a bare raw delta would make a 2-day bar indistinguishable from a 1-day one

decisions.decision: km_per_pct_calc and estimated_range_km_calc are NULL whenever battery_used_pct_calc <= 0; the two raw columns always store the true signed delta
decisions.why: Zero divisor is a division by zero and a negative divisor (overnight charge) yields a meaningless ratio; module convention D12/DSA3 reserves NULL for genuinely undefined and requires a stored 0 to be truthful

decisions.decision: Column naming is <what>_<unit>_calc; ticket's estimated_range_calculated becomes estimated_range_km_calc
decisions.why: Honors both the ticket's requested _calc suffix and CLAUDE.md's non-negotiable display-unit suffix rule, matching the 15 existing unit-suffixed columns on the table

decisions.decision: Backfill every existing row inside the Up migration via a single LAG() window pass

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's refinement of the previous-record definition: bound the lookup by the start of the incoming row's LOCAL CALENDAR DAY, not by its own captured_at
decisions.why: The leader's original wording was wrong under same-day re-capture (upsert): today's existing row has an earlier captured_at and would be selected as its own predecessor, yielding a near-zero delta. The refinement is a strict no-op for fresh inserts. Worker flagged it rather than substituting silently; leader verified the reasoning against the dedupe UNIQUE constraint

decisions.decision: Leader integration fix in attemptVehicle: read the clock ONCE into capturedAt and use it for both snapshotFrom and the dayStart bound, replacing two independent s.now() calls
decisions.why: The wave-4 worker flagged it on a fresh-eyes read of T1-T5. Design D7 defines the predecessor bound as the local calendar day OF THE INCOMING ROW, so deriving it from a second clock reading is not what D7 specifies: two calls straddling local midnight would bound the lookup by a different day than the row being derived. Astronomically unlikely in production and a no-op under the injected test Clock, but it is this change's own wiring and the fix is one line, so it was corrected now rather than deferred
